1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the requirements, the methods of sampling and test for ethylene oxide.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibilities of applying the most recent edition of these standards:
